_readme: Single source of truth for Rob's app catalogue. Rendered by src/_includes/components/app-showcase.njk (public cards on /data/) and src/private-apps.njk (unlinked launch page at /private/apps/). Removing an entry here removes its card everywhere. RULES: launchUrl/demoUrl only when verified - never guess a host, port or subdomain. Never put passwords, passphrases, tokens or credentials in this file. Public demos use demo data only - no real personal data, balances or records. visibility 'public' = launchUrl may be shown on the public showcase; 'private' = launchUrl appears ONLY on the private launchpad page. visibility 'public' also lists the app in the schema.org ItemList JSON-LD on /data/ (built by src/_utils/structured-data.js); private apps never appear in structured data, and the build fails if one does.
